description: Checks CodeWiki aggregate Review for authority preservation and scope-required release evidence.
requirement: The exact integrated aggregate must preserve fixed CodeWiki authority and custody boundaries, prove complete cross-unit realization, and include every packed, external, recovery, containment, provider, lifecycle, and cleanup artifact required by the accepted Change scope.

failure.message: Integrated aggregate fails CodeWiki Project Server integrity or required qualification.
remediation: Return exact evidence-linked feedback to affected Work Unit Implementation or route a Planning or Decision defect through Project Server.
